purpose: Teach: 念願/恐い/只今/ナイフ/マナー/水曜日/金持ち/ウソ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、念願、絶対、の、絶対、新しいバット、絶対、買えたんだね
lines.en: Riku — you actually got that new bat you've been wanting forever, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, genuine admiration. Quick tempo on the opening. Small smile in the voice—she's happy for him and not hiding it. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試験前、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、恐い、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Though man, the timing's rough—test coming up right after.
lines.style: Wry self-awareness. Light, almost rueful laugh threaded through. Self-deprecating without complaint. Warm toward Sakura—he knows she gets why the timing is funny.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、家に、絶対、只今、絶対、って、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、言ってるよね、リク
lines.en: You actually told your parents you'd be home right when you said you would, didn't you? That's not like you.
lines.style: Gentle teasing with real observation underneath. Slow, testing tone—she's noticing something. Slight warmth, not accusation. Trailing upward slightly, inviting him to confirm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、ナイフ、絶対、扱い、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: We learned proper knife technique in home ec, remember? You paid attention.
lines.style: Quiet realization. Thoughtful pace. He's connecting something. Not defensive—actually noting something true about her. Soft conviction on the memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気for、絶対、食事の、絶対、マナー、絶対、ちゃんとしてるよね、リク
lines.en: You're actually following through with dinner manners too, aren't you? That's real progress.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Slightly slower pace—she's genuinely noticing effort. Light pride in her voice, not condescending. Like she's seeing something he doesn't quite see in himself yet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今度の、本気で、絶対、水曜日、絶対、テスト、絶対、頑張ろうぜ、桜
lines.en: We should both crush this test on Wednesday. Come on, let's do this.
lines.style: Shift to determination. Direct, forward-leaning energy. Not asking—inviting. Quick, confident pace. The kind of thing you say when you're in it together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、金持ち、絶対、じゃないけど、絶対、心が、絶対、優しいよ、リク
lines.en: Your grandfather—he's not rich, but man, his heart is so kind. That matters.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Slow opening. Real tenderness here—she's saying something that matters. Slight pause before 'that matters.' Like she's choosing each word carefully.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、絶対、ウソ、絶対、つかない、絶対、性格だよな、桜
lines.en: You never lie to people, you know that? It's one of the things about you.
lines.style: Direct, warm observation. Steady pace. No flourish—just stating something true. Slight softness on the closing. She means it as a compliment and he'll know that.
